doc.description:
Optical-flow based obstacle avoidance for the front camera. Uses the size_divergence field from cv_opticflow to detect obstacles and the derotated lateral flow (flow_der_x) to choose which way to turn.
State machine: SAFE - moving forward, watching divergence OBSTACLE_FOUND - obstacle detected, choosing turn direction TURNING - turning away, waiting for divergence to drop
Tunable parameters (adjustable from GCS Settings tab): oa_divergence_threshold - divergence level that triggers avoidance oa_flow_y_threshold - absolute forward flow threshold that triggers avoidance oa_turn_heading_deg - degrees to turn when obstacle found oa_move_distance - forward step size (metres) each cycle

define.name: OPTICFLOW_AVOIDER_FLOWY_THRESHOLD
define.description: Absolute forward optical flow threshold [subpixels] for obstacle detection (default 45)

define.name: OPTICFLOW_AVOIDER_TURN_HEADING_DEG
define.description: Heading change in degrees when avoiding (default 18)

define.name: OPTICFLOW_AVOIDER_MOVE_DISTANCE
define.description: Forward step distance in metres per cycle (default 1.0)

define.name: OPTICFLOW_AVOIDER_ABI_ID
define.description: ABI sender ID to listen to (default: all senders)
